Features Overview

SF Flow Utility Toolkit is made up of targeted features for Salesforce Flow Builder and related Salesforce automation pages.

The toolkit is designed to improve navigation, documentation, analysis, and day-to-day Flow administration by adding focused enhancements directly into the Salesforce experience.

Available features

  • Flow Health Check
  • Flow Error Explorer
  • Import / Export Flows
  • Scheduled Flow Explorer
  • Unused Resources Finder
  • Flow List Search
  • Canvas Search
  • API Name Generator
  • Flow Version Manager
  • Where Is This Used?
  • Comparison Exporter
  • Missing Description Flags
  • Setup Tabs
  • Flow Trigger Explorer Enhancer
  • Flow Metadata & AI Assistant
  • Autosave
  • Keyboard Shortcuts
